## Historical audit: S0359

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_v3/results/H01/selection/bw_0031/1/trajectory.jsonl`. All line citations below refer to this file. The supplied observations contain complete lines, not split observations; the character ranges identify the cited records.

| Evidence | Observed operation or result |
|---|---|
| H `model_request`, line 1 [0,11492) | The task was to reconstruct an indoor photograph as separate editable 3D objects and match viewpoint and framing. The reference image itself is not visible in this audit. |
| H `model_response` and step 1 `execute`, lines 3 [0,12259), 4 [0,12006) | H interpreted the image as a control room, with an uncertain upper-inset GRID panel location. It produced a complete program containing architecture, a meter wall and vent, long desk, smaller console and cabinet, GRID panel, and ceiling fixtures. Named assets contain child parts; their hierarchy does not prove physical contact or visual correctness. The desk surfaces are tilted. |
| Same program, line 4 [0,12006) | The program assigns a shared color palette and a label material; it does not specify image textures. It configures world lighting, three area emitters, an active panoramic camera and an inactive close-up camera. It also requests Cycles and landscape resolution, whereas the request describes a 374 × 512 reference. The effective output framing and lighting cannot be assessed from the logs alone. |
| Step 1 `build_completed`, `render_completed`, `execution_result` and `select`, lines 6 [0,1564), 8 [0,1554), 9 [0,31600), 10 [0,59) | Build and render returned zero; `ok` was true, a PNG was saved, and step 1 was selected. This is **technical execution success**, not independent evidence of geometric or visual fidelity. Neither the reference nor the resulting image is available to this audit. |
| H second `model_request`, `model_error`, `scene_error`, lines 11 [0,57688), 12 [0,441), 13 [0,1699) | A review request packaged the original and render and asked for a discrepancy ledger and revision. Service submissions were paused before the review response. No discrepancy diagnosis, revised program, second execution, or `DONE` is observed. |

**Teacher input and exploration.** No separate teacher detection, diagnosis, proposed update, or teacher intervention is recorded. The initial system guidance and subsequent review instruction are visible task/runtime inputs, not evidence of a teacher’s assessment. The review images were packaged in a request, but the pause means student receipt or adoption of that review is not established. The first session reports no tool calls (line 2 [0,3688)); H autonomously authored one scene and executed it, but no further exploration is visible.

**Outcome and lessons.** The run was **technically interrupted during review**; overall reconstruction correctness remains unknown, rather than proven partial or formally successful. Transferably, a completed render and named hierarchy establish execution and emitted structure, not reference coverage, part connections, material fidelity, pose, or camera match. Task-specific unresolved hypotheses include whether the GRID inset belongs on the right wall, whether the desk and cabinet connect plausibly, and whether the landscape camera framing matches the portrait reference. None can be resolved without inspecting the actual images and, for connections, the geometry.
